ailab.title: AI LAB
ailab.intro: Here I don't tell you what I can do with AI: I let you try it. Each experiment tells you where it runs, how it's built and what I decided. Most of them run entirely in your browser.
ailab.plugins: I also build AI plugins for specific professions. For a lawyer, skills that organize case material, test hypotheses and draft documents. For a structural engineer, an assistant that reads his logs, helps with calculations and builds the estimate. The showcases below use made-up data only.
ailab.privacy: I don't store your audio or your text. They're processed in your browser and never leave it.
ailab.meta.description: AI experiments that run in your browser: try them, see how they work and read their code.

ailab.v1.title: Transcriber
ailab.v1.summary: Record or upload audio and get the text with timestamps. It uses the same kind of engine as the voice dictation tool I built to write in Spanish with English tech terms.
ailab.v1.privacy: Your audio is transcribed in your browser and never leaves your device.
ailab.v2.title: Text → speech
ailab.v2.summary: Type some text and hear it with your browser's voices, in Spanish or English.
ailab.v2.privacy: The text is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v3.title: Listen to the posts
ailab.v3.summary: The same engine reads a blog post aloud: just the body, without the code blocks, in the page's language.
ailab.v3.privacy: The post is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v4.title: Navigate by voice
ailab.v4.summary: Tell the site where to go: "take me to the blog", "switch to light theme".
ailab.v4.privacy: Your voice becomes text in your browser, and only commands from the site's palette run.
ailab.a2.title: Anatomy of a plugin
ailab.a2.summary: This is how a Claude Code plugin is built: skills, commands, hooks and MCP servers. Tap each file to see what it's for, and build your own at the end.
ailab.a2.privacy: It doesn't download or send anything: it's a tour of the files of a sample plugin.
ailab.a2.intro: A made-up plugin for a bakery: it scales recipes, checks the hydration and never lets a recipe through without its allergens. Tap a file to see what it's for and where the trade comes in.
ailab.a2.keys: With the keyboard: up and down arrows to move, right and left to open and close folders, Enter to open a file, Home and End to jump to the first and the last.
ailab.a2.opened: You opened {file}. Its explanation and its content are next to the tree.
ailab.a2.next: Now that you've seen it inside: build your own skill.
ailab.a3.title: Build your skill
ailab.a3.summary: Write the name, when to use it and its steps, and download a valid SKILL.md, built in your browser.
ailab.a3.privacy: What you write becomes a file in your browser and never leaves it.
ailab.a3.intro: A skill is a set of instructions Claude loads only when they're needed. Write yours and download it: the file is put together here, in your browser.
ailab.a3.name.label: Name
ailab.a3.name.hint: Lowercase letters with no accents, numbers and hyphens, up to {max} characters. For example: check-recipes.
ailab.a3.description.label: What it does and when to use it
ailab.a3.description.hint: Claude always keeps this line in sight to decide whether to use the skill: say what it does and when. Up to {max} characters.
ailab.a3.steps.label: Steps
ailab.a3.steps.hint: One per line; there's no need to number them.
ailab.a3.error.name.required: Write a name for the skill.
ailab.a3.error.name.tooLong: The name has {count} characters: the maximum is {max}.
ailab.a3.error.name.format: Use only lowercase letters with no accents, numbers and hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or the end and no two hyphens in a row.
ailab.a3.error.name.reserved: The name can't include "anthropic" or "claude": they're reserved words.
ailab.a3.error.description.required: Write what the skill does and when to use it.
ailab.a3.error.description.tooLong: The description has {count} characters: the maximum is {max}.
ailab.a3.error.description.markup: Remove the < and > signs: the frontmatter doesn't accept tags.
ailab.a3.example.name: check-recipes
ailab.a3.example.description: Checks that a recipe has its ingredients with grams, its steps and its allergens. Use it when a recipe is written or edited.
ailab.a3.example.steps:
Read the whole recipe.
Check that every ingredient has its grams.
Check that the allergens section exists.
Say what is missing, without making up amounts.
ailab.a3.local: Nothing is sent: the file is put together and downloaded from your browser.
ailab.a3.invalid: Check the marked fields before downloading.
ailab.a3.downloaded: Done: you downloaded SKILL.md. Save it in .claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md.
ailab.a3.where: It goes in .claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md in your project, or in ~/.claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md to use it everywhere.
ailab.a5.title: Glass-box search
ailab.a5.summary: Ask something about the blog, the projects or my career, and see the passages it found, with their score and their source.
ailab.a5.privacy: Your question is searched in your browser, over the site's index, and isn't sent anywhere.
ailab.a5.label: Your question
ailab.a5.placeholder: For example: how does Synergos handle sagas?
ailab.a5.hint: Results show up as you type. I search for words, not meanings.
ailab.a5.failed: I couldn't load the site's index. Check your connection and try again.
ailab.a5.ready: Index ready: {count} documents from the site, and the search runs in your browser.
ailab.a5.empty: Nothing matches "{query}". Try other words: I search for words, not meanings.
ailab.a5.terms: Your question, as the search engine sees it
ailab.a5.term.documents: It shows up in {count} of {total} documents: the rarer a word is, the more it weighs.
ailab.a5.field.title: the title (×{boost})
ailab.a5.total: Sum {sum} × {matched} of your words that matched = {score}
ailab.a5.legend.title: How the score is worked out
ailab.a5.legend: It's BM25, with the same index and the same search engine the site's assistant uses. A word that is rare on the site weighs more than a common one, and it weighs more in a short text. The title counts ×4, the keywords ×2 and the text ×1. A match by prefix or a close match counts less than an exact one. At the end, the sum is multiplied by how many of your words matched.
ailab.a5.meaning: Search by meaning, which would download multilingual-e5-small, isn't here yet: first I'm measuring what it costs the build to precompute its vectors.
ailab.r1.title: Saga simulator
ailab.r1.summary: Book a trip and take down a service in the middle of the payment. Watch the system undo what was already done, and why undoing a booking isn't the same as releasing a hold.
ailab.r1.privacy: It's a simulation in your browser: it doesn't use or store any of your data.
ailab.r1.fail.locked: You can't change the failure while the saga runs: finish it or start over.
ailab.r1.direction: Compensation runs from the last completed step back to the first.
ailab.r1.legend.hold.desc: Something provisional: the hotel and the rental agency keep the room and the car while the payment arrives. Releasing it leaves no trace and costs nothing.
ailab.r1.legend.booking.desc: It already exists in the provider's system, like the flight. Undoing it is another operation, a cancellation, which gets recorded and may cost money.
ailab.r1.logEmpty: Pick which service goes down and press “Book the trip” or “Next step”.
ailab.r1.log.start: The saga starts: book a flight, a hotel and a car, and charge at the end.
ailab.r1.log.request.flight: Flight: the airline is asked for a booking.
ailab.r1.log.done.flight: Flight: the airline confirms booking {ref}. It doesn't hold: it issues the booking right away.
ailab.r1.log.fail.flight: Flight: the airline doesn't respond. It's the first step, so there's nothing to undo.
ailab.r1.log.done.hotel: Hotel: it holds room {ref} while the payment arrives, without charging yet.
ailab.r1.log.fail.hotel: Hotel: the service doesn't respond. Compensation starts, in reverse order.
ailab.r1.log.request.car: Car: the rental agency is asked for a car.
ailab.r1.log.done.car: Car: the agency holds car {ref} while the payment arrives.
ailab.r1.log.fail.car: Car: the agency doesn't respond. Compensation starts, in reverse order.
ailab.r1.log.request.payment: Payment: the gateway is asked to charge.
ailab.r1.log.fail.payment: Payment: the payment gateway goes down mid-payment and nothing is charged. Compensation starts, in reverse order.
ailab.r1.log.release.car: Car: the system releases the hold {ref}. Nothing had been committed: the car is available again and it costs nothing.
ailab.r1.log.release.hotel: Hotel: the system releases the hold {ref}. The room is free again, at no cost.
ailab.r1.log.cancel.flight: Flight: the system cancels the booking {ref}. That booking already existed, so undoing it is a new operation the airline records, and it may carry a penalty.
ailab.r1.log.confirm.hotel: Hotel: with the payment approved, hold {ref} becomes a confirmed booking.
ailab.r1.log.confirm.car: Car: with the payment approved, hold {ref} becomes a confirmed booking.
ailab.r1.log.end.completed: Saga complete: the trip is booked and paid.
ailab.r1.log.end.compensated: Saga compensated: what was done got undone, from the last step back to the first, and nothing was left halfway.
ailab.r1.outcome.completed: Trip booked: flight, hotel and car with confirmed bookings, and the payment charged.
ailab.r1.outcome.compensated: Saga compensated. Holds released: {released}. Bookings cancelled: {cancelled}. Nothing was charged and nothing was left halfway.
ailab.a4.title: Showcases: Despacho and Obra
ailab.a4.summary: Despacho turns a fictional case into facts with evidence and a timeline. Obra turns a sample log into quantities and an estimate in COP, with Python in your browser.
ailab.a4.privacy: Made-up data. Despacho doesn't download anything, and Obra calculates in your browser.
ailab.a4.tab.despacho.hint: For a lawyer: facts with their evidence and a timeline
ailab.a4.tab.obra.hint: For a structural engineer: a site log and an estimate with Python
ailab.a4.despacho.madeUp: Made-up data: the case, the people and the documents are fictional.
ailab.a4.despacho.pregenerated: Results pregenerated with the plugin's method: no model runs here and nothing is downloaded.
ailab.a4.despacho.status.label: Status of the fact
ailab.a4.despacho.timeline: Timeline, with how certain each date is
ailab.a4.despacho.certainty.label: Certainty
ailab.a4.despacho.limits: The method doesn't weigh the evidence, count deadlines or say who is right: it organizes the material so the lawyer can decide.
ailab.a4.obra.madeUp: Made-up data: the log, the measurements and the prices are samples.

ailab.j1.title: Rally against the AI
ailab.j1.summary: Play against a rival that starts clumsy and learns live, game after game. Watch its brain light up with every decision.
ailab.j1.privacy: What the rival learns stays only in your browser, and you can delete it.
ailab.j2.title: Play against your clone
ailab.j2.summary: After a few rallies, the rival learns your style. Play against an AI that moves like you.
ailab.j2.privacy: Your moves train the clone in your browser and never leave it.
